overview: The **Order** drop-in emits order placement events and resets the cart after successful checkout, coordinating the transition from cart to order confirmation.

order/data.description: Emitted when order data is loaded or updated. This includes order details, items, shipping information, and payment status.

order.description: The complete order data structure including order ID, items, totals, shipping address, and current status.

order/error.description: Emitted when an error occurs during order operations such as fetching order details, reordering items, or processing returns.

error.description: Error details including message, code, and context about which order operation failed.

order/initialized.description: Emitted when the order component completes initialization. This indicates the order data is loaded and the component is ready to display order information.
